    (hpt : ∀ x, Tendsto (fun i => φ i x) l (nhds (ψ x))) (f : Lp 𝕜 2 μ) :

source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  refine (Lp.tendsto_Lp_iff_tendsto_eLpNorm' _ _).mpr ?_
  have hcongr : ∀ i : ι,
      eLpNorm ((lpBoundedMulCLM (p := 2) (μ := μ) (hφ i) hC0 (hCi i) f : α → 𝕜)
          - (lpBoundedMulCLM (p := 2) (μ := μ) hψ hC0 hCψ f : α → 𝕜)) 2 μ
        = eLpNorm (fun x => (φ i x - ψ x) * (f : α → 𝕜) x) 2 μ := by
    intro i
    refine eLpNorm_congr_ae ?_
    filter_upwards [lpBoundedMulCLM_coeFn (p := 2) (μ := μ) (hφ i) hC0 (hCi i) f,
      lpBoundedMulCLM_coeFn (p := 2) (μ := μ) hψ hC0 hCψ f] with x h1 h2
    rw [Pi.sub_apply, h1, h2, sub_mul]
  simp_rw [hcongr]
  have hform : ∀ i : ι, eLpNorm (fun x => (φ i x - ψ x) * (f : α → 𝕜) x) 2 μ
      = (∫⁻ x, ‖(φ i x - ψ x) * (f : α → 𝕜) x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂μ) ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ)) := by
    intro i
    rw [eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  simp_rw [hform]
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun i : ι => ∫⁻ x, ‖(φ i x - ψ x) * (f : α → 𝕜) x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂μ) l
      (nhds 0) := by
    have hzero : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) = ∫⁻ _x : α, (0 : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μ := by simp
    rw [hzero]
    refine tendsto_lintegral_filter_of_dominated_convergence'
      (bound := fun x => ‖(2 * C : ℝ)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) * ‖(f : α → 𝕜) x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun i => ?_
      have hmeas : AEMeasurable (fun x => (φ i x - ψ x) * (f : α → 𝕜) x) μ :=
        (((hφ i).sub hψ).aemeasurable).mul (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f).aemeasurable
      exact (hmeas.enorm.pow_const _)
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun i => Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_
      have hr : ‖φ i x - ψ x‖ ≤ 2 * C := by
        have h1 := hCi i x
        have h2 := hCψ x
        have := norm_sub_le (φ i x) (ψ x)
        linarith
      have hb : ‖φ i x - ψ x‖ₑ ≤ ‖(2 * C : ℝ)‖ₑ := by
        rw [← ofReal_norm, ← ofReal_norm]
        refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
        exact hr
      calc ‖(φ i x - ψ x) * (f : α → 𝕜) x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ)
          = (‖φ i x - ψ x‖ₑ * ‖(f : α → 𝕜) x‖ₑ) ^ (2 : ℝ) := by rw [enorm_mul]
        _ ≤ (‖(2 * C : ℝ)‖ₑ * ‖(f : α → 𝕜) x‖ₑ) ^ (2 : ℝ) :=
            ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow (by gcongr) (by norm_num)
        _ = ‖(2 * C : ℝ)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) * ‖(f : α → 𝕜) x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) :=
            ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (by norm_num)
    · rw [lintegral_const_mul' _ _ (by finiteness)]
      exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by finiteness) (lintegral_enorm_rpow_two_ne_top f)
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_
      have h1 : Tendsto (fun i => (φ i x - ψ x) * (f : α → 𝕜) x) l (nhds 0) := by
        have h := ((hpt x).sub (tendsto_const_nhds (x := ψ x))).mul_const ((f : α → 𝕜) x)
        simpa using h
      have h2 : Tendsto (fun i => ‖(φ i x - ψ x) * (f : α → 𝕜) x‖ₑ) l (nhds ‖(0 : 𝕜)‖ₑ) :=
        ((ContinuousENorm.continuous_enorm (E := 𝕜)).tendsto (0 : 𝕜)).comp h1
      rw [enorm_zero] at h2
      have h3 : Tendsto (fun i => ‖(φ i x - ψ x) * (f : α → 𝕜) x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ)) l
          (nhds ((0 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (2 : ℝ))) :=
        (ENNReal.continuous_rpow_const.tendsto (0 : ℝ≥0∞)).comp h2
      rwa [ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos (by norm_num)] at h3
  have hfinal : Tendsto
      (fun i : ι => (∫⁻ x, ‖(φ i x - ψ x) * (f : α → 𝕜) x‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂μ) ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ))) l
      (nhds ((0 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (1 / (2 : ℝ)))) :=
    (ENNReal.continuous_rpow_const.tendsto (0 : ℝ≥0∞)).comp hlim
  rwa [ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos (by norm_num)] at hfinal

by
  obtain ⟨delta, hdelta, hgap⟩ := exists_xiSpectralPoint_gap (z₀ : ℂ)
  have hnear : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ‖(z n : ℂ) - (z₀ : ℂ)‖ ≤ delta / 2 := by
    have hball : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (z n : ℂ) ∈ closedBall (z₀ : ℂ) (delta / 2) :=
      hz.eventually (Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds (z₀ : ℂ) (half_pos hdelta))
    filter_upwards [hball] with n hn
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hn
  let term : ℕ → XiZeroCopy → ℝ := fun n q ↦
    ‖xiWeilCauchyTest (z n : ℂ) (xiSpectralPoint q) -
      xiWeilCauchyTest (z₀ : ℂ) (xiSpectralPoint q)‖ ^ 2
  let bound : XiZeroCopy → ℝ := fun q ↦
    9 * ‖xiWeilCauchyTest (z₀ : ℂ) (xiSpectralPoint q)‖ ^ 2
  have hboundsum : Summable bound :=
    (XiWeilSquareSummable_cauchy (z₀ : ℂ)).mul_left 9
  have hterm_tend : ∀ q, Tendsto (fun n ↦ term n q) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro q
    have hden : xiSpectralPoint q - (z₀ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro heq
      apply z₀.property
      apply (XiC_eq_zero_iff_exists_xiZeroCopy (z₀ : ℂ)).mpr
      exact ⟨q, sub_eq_zero.mp heq⟩
    have hdenT : Tendsto
        (fun n ↦ xiSpectralPoint q - (z n : ℂ)) atTop
        (nhds (xiSpectralPoint q - (z₀ : ℂ))) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.sub hz
    have hinv : Tendsto
        (fun n ↦ (xiSpectralPoint q - (z n : ℂ))⁻¹) atTop
        (nhds ((xiSpectralPoint q - (z₀ : ℂ))⁻¹)) :=
      hdenT.inv₀ hden
    have hconst : Tendsto
        (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (xiSpectralPoint q - (z₀ : ℂ))⁻¹) atTop
        (nhds ((xiSpectralPoint q - (z₀ : ℂ))⁻¹)) := tendsto_const_nhds
    simpa [term, xiWeilCauchyTest] using (hinv.sub hconst).norm.pow 2
  have hbound : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ q, ‖term n q‖ ≤ bound q := by
    filter_upwards [hnear] with n hn
    intro q
    have hqne : xiSpectralPoint q ≠ (z₀ : ℂ) := by
      intro hq
      apply z₀.property
      exact (XiC_eq_zero_iff_exists_xiZeroCopy (z₀ : ℂ)).mpr ⟨q, hq⟩
    have hqgap := hgap q hqne
    have hhalf : ‖xiSpectralPoint q - (z₀ : ℂ)‖ / 2 ≤
        ‖xiSpectralPoint q - (z n : ℂ)‖ := by
      have hrev := norm_sub_norm_le
        (xiSpectralPoint q - (z₀ : ℂ)) ((z n : ℂ) - (z₀ : ℂ))
      have hid : (xiSpectralPoint q - (z₀ : ℂ)) -
          ((z n : ℂ) - (z₀ : ℂ)) = xiSpectralPoint q - (z n : ℂ) := by ring
      rw [hid] at hrev
      linarith
    have hqpos : 0 < ‖xiSpectralPoint q - (z₀ : ℂ)‖ :=
      norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hqne)
    have hninv :
        ‖xiWeilCauchyTest (z n : ℂ) (xiSpectralPoint q)‖ ≤
          2 / ‖xiSpectralPoint q - (z₀ : ℂ)‖ := by
      rw [xiWeilCauchyTest, norm_inv]
      rw [show ‖xiSpectralPoint q - (z n : ℂ)‖⁻¹ =
          1 / ‖xiSpectralPoint q - (z n : ℂ)‖ by rw [one_div]]
      exact (one_div_le_one_div_of_le (half_pos hqpos) hhalf).trans_eq (by field_simp)
    have h₀inv :
        ‖xiWeilCauchyTest (z₀ : ℂ) (xiSpectralPoint q)‖ =
          1 / ‖xiSpectralPoint q - (z₀ : ℂ)‖ := by
      rw [xiWeilCauchyTest, norm_inv, one_div]
    have hdiff :
        ‖xiWeilCauchyTest (z n : ℂ) (xiSpectralPoint q) -
          xiWeilCauchyTest (z₀ : ℂ) (xiSpectralPoint q)‖ ≤
          3 / ‖xiSpectralPoint q - (z₀ : ℂ)‖ := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ‖xiWeilCauchyTest (z n : ℂ) (xiSpectralPoint q)‖ +
            ‖xiWeilCauchyTest (z₀ : ℂ) (xiSpectralPoint q)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ 2 / ‖xiSpectralPoint q - (z₀ : ℂ)‖ +
            1 / ‖xiSpectralPoint q - (z₀ : ℂ)‖ := by
              exact add_le_add hninv h₀inv.le
        _ = 3 / ‖xiSpectralPoint q - (z₀ : ℂ)‖ := by ring
    dsimp only [term, bound]
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hdiff 2
    rw [h₀inv]
    calc
      _ ≤ (3 / ‖xiSpectralPoint q - (z₀ : ℂ)‖) ^ 2 := hsq
      _ = 9 * (1 / ‖xiSpectralPoint q - (z₀ : ℂ)‖) ^ 2 := by ring
  have htsum : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∑' q, term n q) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence hboundsum hterm_tend hbound
  rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
  have hnormsq : ∀ n, ‖xiWeilCauchyLp (z n) - xiWeilCauchyLp z₀‖ ^ 2 =

    intro n

    rfl

## Correction — `(4)` CANNOT be reached through pointwise a.e. convergence

The Lean bridge in `RadialLeakageWeakConvergenceTransfer.lean` derives `(4)` from two hypotheses:
a.e. pointwise convergence of the finite density (`hae`) and convergence of its total mass
(`hmass`).  **`hae` is false for this family**, so that hypothesis can never be discharged and the
bridge is the wrong interface for this card.

The reason is visible in the card's own proof.  By `(8)`–`(11)`,

```text
lambda|q_lambda(lambda x)|^2/d_1(lambda)
  ~ (const/x) * (2/(pi sqrt(x^2-1))) * cos^2(c xi(x) - pi/4)
```

and for **fixed** `x > 1` the factor `cos^2(c xi(x) - pi/4)` oscillates in `[0,1]` as `c -> infinity`
without converging.  Only its mean value `1/2` survives, and it survives only after integration
against a test function.  That is exactly why §1 of the proof says "applying nonstationary phase on
every compact subinterval": the convergence in `(12)` is **weak**, not pointwise, and no
subsequence-free pointwise statement is true.

So the correct Lean route to `(4)` is the genuine weak one:

```text
for f continuous with compact support in (1, infinity),
  integral f dnu_lambda -> integral f dnu_infinity ,
```

obtained by writing `cos^2 theta = (1 + cos 2theta)/2`, keeping the constant half, and killing the
oscillating half by a Riemann--Lebesgue/nonstationary-phase estimate along `xi`, whose derivative
`xi'(x) = sqrt((x^2 - sigma^2)/(x^2-1))` is bounded away from zero on every compact subinterval of
`(1, infinity)`.  Tightness at the two ends is `(13)`.

`hmass` is not the problem: by evenness `integral_1^infinity dnu_lambda = (1/2) delta_lambda/d_1(lambda)`,
and `(3)` — already formal — gives `-> 4/11`.
